region.name: Kosi River Basin
region.bbox_note: Approximate viewing frame around the Koshi Barrage (26.5263 N, 86.9269 E) and the northern Bihar districts named in public accounts of the 2008 flood. This is not an ingested flood extent.

event.name: Kosi / Koshi Flood
event.satellite_source: Terra and Aqua MODIS, 250 m, via the Global Flood Database. Not ingested. Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 are not used for this event.
event.note: The embankment breach is dated 18 August 2008 in public accounts (GFDRR; Wikipedia summary of the event). The Global Flood Database event start and end dates have not been retrieved. No end date is shown.

supporting_sources.name: GFDRR note on the 18 August 2008 Kosi embankment breach

scenarios.bbox_note: Konkan viewing frame around Chiplun. Not a mapped flood extent.
scenarios.extent_source: No flood-extent raster is ingested for this event.

scenarios.bbox_note: Teesta valley viewing frame. Not a mapped flood extent. The lake coordinate is not stored.
scenarios.extent_source: No flood-extent raster is ingested for this event.
